name: Codespaces Latest
postCreateCommand: pnpm install && pnpm build && sudo wp core install --allow-root --path=/var/www/html --url="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-8080.app.github.dev" --title=Healthy --admin_user=admin --admin_password=admin --admin_email=admin@example.com && sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html && sudo ln -sfn "$(pwd)/dist" /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/healthy
postStartCommand: chmod +x .devcontainer/codespaces.sh && .devcontainer/codespaces.sh && sudo wp plugin is-installed plugin-check --allow-root --path=/var/www/html || sudo wp plugin install plugin-check --activate --allow-root --path=/var/www/html && sudo apache2ctl -D FOREGROUND
